title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: Grilled lamb kebabs made with zesty and smoky flavors, inspired by the cuisine of Saudi Arabia. This keto-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Zesty Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: Use a zesty olive oil to add flavor to the kebabs

ingredients.name: Smoked Paprika
ingredients.notes: Add a smoky flavor to the kebabs

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality salt to enhance the flavors

ingredients.name: Black Pepper
ingredients.notes: Use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: Use freshly squeezed lemon juice for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Minced and mixed with olive oil

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve immediately, with a squeeze of lemon juice on top.
